comment: One subagent on the reply card: a panel of its own, collapsed, holding what it reported.
Secondary by design — the run folds the answer into its own reply, and this is where a reader
goes to see what the work behind that reply actually was. The two placeholders are filled in
FeishuSubagentPanel: {panelId}, {bodyId} and {footerId} are element ids, {title} says which
subagent this is and how it is getting on, {body} is what it has said so far, and {footer} is
what it has spent saying it. A deployment replacing this file has to keep all six, and keep the
body and footer elements text ones: the run streams into both of them by id.
The header fills the panel's width and carries its own horizontal padding, so the title reads
as a row of its own rather than as text floating beside the chevron; the chevron therefore sits
at the right edge rather than following the text. This key is ignored when the panel is built.
